subject: Armor Evade
text: Wearing armor lowers your evade percentage, meaning armor evade % acts as a penalty.

evidence.quote:
A little note about the
evade % on the armors. This should actually be a negative affect, since
if you check your armor while wearing armor and without (be sure to add
up all the evade % first), and you'll see that it actually lowers your
evade.
